主要内容: The document titled 'Form 6-K' was published on February 28, 2013, by the Royal Bank of Canada. It is a report filed under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, specifically under Rule 15d-16. The report includes a section titled 'Exhibit Index' with a description of Exhibit 99.1, which is the 'Royal Bank of Canada – Report of Voting Results.' The document is part of the regulatory filings required by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The Royal Bank of Canada is a major Canadian financial institution, and this filing reflects its compliance with U.S. securities regulations. The report does not provide detailed financial results but outlines the bank's voting results, which may be relevant to shareholder activities.
